name: visual-forge-studio
description: A visual design studio that turns a text brief into finished visuals: page interfaces, brand colour systems, social graphics, interactive web tools, generative art, image generation and optimisation — all held to one consistent brand line, with 67 named design-system specs (tokens, component rules, WCAG 2.2 AA, QA gates) ready to apply.

displayDescription.en: From a text brief to finished visuals: interfaces, colour systems, social graphics, interactive tools and generative art, with 67 ready-to-apply design-system specs.
displayDescription.zh: 从文字需求到成品视觉：界面、配色、社媒图、交互工具与生成艺术，67 种设计规范开箱即用。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我只有一段文字描述，帮我把它做成一套完整的视觉方案
defaultInitPrompt.en: I only have a text brief — turn it into a complete visual system

quickPrompts.zh: 我只有一段文字描述，帮我把它做成一套完整的视觉方案
quickPrompts.en: I only have a text brief — turn it into a complete visual system

quickPrompts.zh: 用一句话品牌感觉，生成配色与字体方案并落到 CSS 变量
quickPrompts.en: Describe the brand feel in one line and turn it into a colour and type system in CSS variables

quickPrompts.zh: 给这套视觉做一次品牌一致性检查，列出所有跑偏的地方
quickPrompts.en: Audit this set of visuals for brand consistency and list every deviation
